subject.title: System prompt should prefer Skill tool over read when available

question: What trusted skill-loader contract, if any, should plugins be allowed to provide across OpenClaw harnesses?
rationale: Current Codex behavior is typed and harness-owned; an ordinary plugin tool name cannot establish equivalent authority, schema, source validation, or injection semantics.

options.title: Typed cross-harness loader
options.body: Add an explicit loader capability with authority, schema, and injection semantics shared by native and Codex integrations.

options.title: Native named-tool convention
options.body: Recognize a tool named `Skill` only in the native prompt and document its weaker convention, trust assumptions, and collision behavior.

options.title: Retain direct reads
options.body: Keep direct SKILL.md reads as the sole native loading contract and reject authoritative plugin loaders.

recommendation.title: Typed cross-harness loader
recommendation.body: Add an explicit loader capability with authority, schema, and injection semantics shared by native and Codex integrations.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and recently maintained the central prompt behavior and has already reviewed this issue and its adjacent design direction.
